review_text: If you’re looking for affordable rice meals and good coffee or matcha, here’s one neighbourhood cafe you’d like to try. Space has only 4 tables, and mostly orders from Grab. We passed this yesterday and thankfully it’s still open on Maundy Thursday. They have limited free parking.
food was sooo good & comforting. they also have light snacks, heavy meals, and very lami and dili umay na desserts. the place itself is really cozy, comfy, and welcoming also.
fav place!!! good food and super clean!! 💯
Nice place really, and very affordable. A must visit👌🏻

Takeout drinks the first time were not bad. Service was slow though. Succeeding attempts in the mornings (around 9) was a fail. (The sign read differently). Found out the store opens at 11 a.m. and not 10. On Google Maps it was 9 a.m. Reasonable rates with few food choices. Not bad for a small café.
